• a collaborative spirit and energy for working in a team, as well as curiosity, self-reliance, and initiative-taking

• an interest in science communication, with a focus on research that has practical impact

Today, leaders are encouraged to be open about their personal flaws (i.e., negative personal characteristics) at work. For example, an award-winning Harvard Business Review article advises business leaders to “show us who they are–warts and all,” like admitting being irritable, disorganized, or shy. Supporting this idea, self-disclosure theory has long suggested that revealing aspects of one's self to others builds stronger connections with them. Similarly, the literature on authenticity suggests that leaders who are more open and transparent are more effec-tive. These examples from science and practice all suggest that leaders who let their guard down and openly show their more negative sides can be more successful.

However, this optimistic view takes a one-size-fits-all approach that neglects aspects of human diversity, including leader attributes like gender, age, and race. This research project thus examines how leader diversity influences self-disclosure of flaws in the workplace. For members of social groups that are already underrepresented in leadership positions and face stereotypes in leadership (e.g., women), being open about certain personal flaws could present a risk for leaders rather than an advantage (e.g., constituting a social norm violation that prompts backlash).

The proposed research has meaningful societal implications as leadership is becoming more diverse and more personal. The insights from this research inform dialogues among practitioners and the public that, right now, reinforce the notion that leaders should be their true selves at work. Results will help to unpack whether openly disclosing personal flaws at work is a privilege that only some leaders may enjoy. Heute werden Führungskräfte ermutigt, offen über ihre persönlichen Fehler (dh negative persönliche Eigenschaften) bei der Arbeit zu sein. Zum Beispiel rät ein preisgekrönter Harvard Business Review-Artikel Wirtschaftsführern, "uns zu zeigen, wer sie sind - Warzen und alle", wie zuzugeben, gereizt, unorganisiert oder schüchtern zu sein. Die Theorie der Selbstoffenlegung, die diese Idee unterstützt, hat lange vorgeschlagen, dass die Enthüllung von Aspekten des eigenen Selbst für andere stärkere Verbindungen mit ihnen aufbaut. In ähnlicher Weise legt die Literatur über Authentizität nahe, dass Führungskräfte, die offener und transparenter sind, effektiver sind. Diese Beispiele aus Wissenschaft und Praxis deuten alle darauf hin, dass Führungskräfte, die ihre Wachsamkeit aufgeben und offen ihre negativeren Seiten zeigen, erfolgreicher sein können.

Diese optimistische Sichtweise verfolgt jedoch einen einheitlichen Ansatz, der Aspekte der menschlichen Vielfalt vernachlässigt, einschließlich Führungsmerkmale wie Geschlecht, Alter und Rasse. In diesem Forschungsprojekt wird daher untersucht, wie Führungsdiversität die Selbstaufklärung von Fehlern am Arbeitsplatz beeinflusst. Für Mitglieder sozialer Gruppen, die in Führungspositionen bereits unterrepräsentiert sind und in Führungspositionen Stereotypen ausgesetzt sind (z. B. Frauen), könnte die Offenheit gegenüber bestimmten persönlichen Fehlern eher ein Risiko für Führungskräfte als einen Vorteil darstellen (z. B. eine Verletzung der sozialen Norm, die zu Rückschlägen führt).

Die vorgeschlagene Forschung hat bedeutende gesellschaftliche Implikationen, da die Führung vielfältiger und persönlicher wird. Die Erkenntnisse aus dieser Forschung informieren Dialoge zwischen Praktizierenden und der Öffentlichkeit, die derzeit die Vorstellung verstärken, dass Führungskräfte ihr wahres Selbst bei der Arbeit sein sollten. Die Ergebnisse werden dazu beitragen, herauszufinden, ob die offene Offenlegung persönlicher Mängel bei der Arbeit ein Privileg ist, das nur einige Führungskräfte genießen können. Bereits jetzt sind Frauen und andere nicht vertretene Gruppen benachteiligt, wenn es um die Ausübung von Führungspositionen geht. Trends, die Führungskräfte ermutigen, offen über persönliche Fehler zu sein, können riskieren, diese Unterschiede zu verschärfen - oder alternativ dazu, sie zu verbessern.

jobs.description:
The University of Zurich, Switzerland's largest university, offers a range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional apprenticeship streams the University offers an inspiring working environment on cutting-edge research and top-class education. Put your talent and skills to work with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
Individual work on a PhD project and related research activities such as conference papers, publications and applications for external funding; independent teaching (two hours per week at BA level) as well as support in research projects and administrative tasks at the Chair.

Anforderungen:
We are looking for a member of staff with an outstanding MA degree in the field of English Literature and promising ideas for a PhD project that intersects with (some of) the Chair's main research areas, i.e. English Literature since 1800, especially the long nineteenth century and its afterlife, gender studies, economic criticism, intermediality and film. You will be well versed in literary history and critical theory, have didactic skills and enjoy working in a team. You will be proficient in verbal, written and interpersonal communication in English and have a competence in German or are eager to acquire a working knowledge of German within the first two years.

jobs.description:
The University of Zurich offers a wide range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and 12 professional apprenticeship streams, Switzerland's largest university provides an inspiring working environment at the vanguard of research and education. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
You are a dynamic and integrative individual with extensive expertise in proton radiation therapy, including the clinical care of patients. You hold a specialist qualification in radiation oncology/radiotherapy or an equivalent qualification and you have comprehensive clinical experience across the entire field of radiation oncology, including pediatric oncology, as well as clinical and scientific expertise in particle therapy and high-precision radiation therapy. A habilitation or an equivalent academic qualification is required. You have published in relevant scientific journals and possess experience in leading research projects, successfully acquiring competitive third-party funding as a principal investigator, as well as enthusiasm in teaching students and fostering early-career academics. Your participatory and goal-oriented leadership approach ensures an attractive working environment for academic and clinical specialists.

Anforderungen:
The University of Zurich is a highly attractive institution for cutting edge research with plenty of opportunities for collaborations across its faculties and with its university hospitals. The successful candidate is expected to strengthen the existing as well as new collaborations between the university hospitals and the PSI.

The PSI is the largest research institute for natural and engineering sciences in Switzerland. It conducts cutting-edge research in the fields of future technologies, energy and climate, health innovation, and the fundamentals of nature. Through both basic and applied research, PSI works on sustainable solutions to key challenges facing society, science, and industry. The Center for Proton Therapy combines clinical patient care with cutting edge scientific research. Thanks to its strong national network and its active international research activities, it enjoys an excellent global reputation.

German language skills at level B2 of the common European framework of reference for languages should be available or must be acquired within a reasonable period of time.

The University of Zurich and the Paul Scherrer Institute are equal opportunities employers and in particular strive to increase the percentage of women in leading positions. Therefore, qualified female researchers are encouraged to apply.

Both institutions see researchers as modern leadership personalities who conduct excellent research - taking into account the Open Science principles - through their own research projects, promote excellent young researchers and who help to shape a forward-looking university with innovative research-based teaching.

Our employees benefit from a wide range of attractive offers .

jobs.description:
The University of Zurich, Switzerland's largest university, offers a range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional apprenticeship streams the University offers an inspiring working environment on cutting-edge research and top-class education. Put your talent and skills to work with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
Specific project goals:
• Generate CAR immune cell communities, comprising mixtures of engineered T cells, NK cells, monocytes, and additional cell types, using sophisticated in vitro and in vivo engineering platforms.

• Identify co-factors that boost CAR immune cell function using cutting-edge screening platforms.

• Investigate anti-tumor activity and immune-cancer-cell environmental crosstalk in vitro and in vivo using sophisticated disease models (organoids, slice cultures, patient-derived samples, mouse models) and modern technologies including flow cytometry, multiplexed imaging, spatial transcriptomics/proteomics and single-cell profiling.

• Analyze patient samples from an accompanying clinical trial evaluating CAR immune cell communities.

Anforderungen:
• Intellectual curiosity, creativity and a proactive approach to problem-solving

• Motivation to contribute to a project with direct patient impact

• PhD in immunology, computational immunology, cell/molecular/cancer biology, bioengineering, biomedical sciences, or a related field

• Experience with immune cell engineering, cellular immunotherapy, and/or advanced in vitro/in vivo disease models is highly desirable

• Familiarity with single-cell and/or spatial technologies is a plus

• Strong publication record demonstrating scientific productivity

• Excellent communication skills and the ability to thrive in an interdisciplinary team

Our employees benefit from a wide range of attractive offers. Find out more: https://www.uzh.ch/de/explore/work.html.

Aufgaben:
Obiettivi specifici del progetto:
• Generare comunità di cellule immunitarie CAR, che comprendono miscele di cellule T ingegnerizzate, cellule NK, monociti e tipi di cellule aggiuntive, utilizzando sofisticate piattaforme ingegneristiche in vitro e in vivo.

• Identificare i cofattori che aumentano la funzione delle cellule immunitarie CAR utilizzando piattaforme di screening all'avanguardia.

• Indagare attività antitumorale e crosstalk ambientale immuno-cancro-cell in vitro e in vivo utilizzando sofisticati modelli di malattia (organoidi, culture a fette, campioni derivati dal paziente, modelli del mouse) e tecnologie moderne tra cui citometria di flusso, imaging multiplexed, trascrizione spaziale/proteomics e profilazione monocellulare.

• Analizzare i campioni dei pazienti da uno studio clinico di accompagnamento che valuta le comunità delle cellule immunitarie di CAR.

Anforderungen:
• Curiosità intellettuale, creatività e approccio proattivo alla risoluzione dei problemi

• Motivazione per contribuire a un progetto con impatto diretto del paziente

• PhD in immunologia, immunologia computazionale, biologia cellulare/molecolare/cancro, bioingegneria, scienze biomediche, o un campo correlato

• L'esperienza con l'ingegneria delle cellule immunitarie, l'immunoterapia cellulare e/o i modelli avanzati di malattia in vitro/in vivo è altamente auspicabile

• La familiarità con le tecnologie singole e/o spaziali è un plus

• Forte record di pubblicazione che dimostra la produttività scientifica

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e la capacità di prosperare in un team interdisciplinare

jobs.description:
The University of Zurich, Switzerland's largest university, offers a range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional apprenticeship streams the University offers an inspiring working environment on cutting-edge research and top-class education. Put your talent and skills to work with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
• Plan, coordinate and conduct in vivo studies in mouse models of genetic liver disease required for the initiation of clinical trials.

• Administer genome-editing therapeutics and other test substances using relevant routes of delivery.

• Perform animal monitoring, blood and tissue collection, necropsies, organ harvesting and downstream sample processing.

• Perform molecular and cellular biology experiments, including mammalian cell culture, DNA and RNA isolation, PCR/qPCR, cloning and preparation of samples for sequencing.

• Analyse, interpret and document experimental results and contribute to the optimisation of experimental protocols.

• Maintain accurate records and ensure that all animal experiments are conducted in accordance with approved protocols and Swiss animal-welfare regulations.

• Collaborate closely with scientists, students and external project partners across several parallel research projects.

Anforderungen:
• BSc or MSc in molecular biology, biotechnology, biomedicine, veterinary medicine, pharmaceutical sciences or a related discipline.

• Substantial hands-on experience conducting experiments with mice is essential.

• Candidates should be confident in animal handling and in relevant experimental procedures such as dosing/injections, monitoring, blood sampling, tissue collection and necropsy.

• Strong practical experience in molecular and cellular biology (cloning, cell culture) and careful handling of biological samples.

• Experience with CRISPR genome editing, RNA therapeutics, lipid nanoparticles, viral vectors, liver biology or metabolic disease models is an advantage but not required.

• Ability to organise and conduct experiments independently, troubleshoot procedures and contribute effectively to multiple projects.

• A highly reliable, precise and collaborative working style, with strong attention to animal welfare and experimental documentation.

• Good written and spoken English.

Wir bieten:
Our employees benefit from a wide range of attractive offers. Find out more: https://www.uzh.ch/de/explore/work.html.

jobs.description:
The University of Zurich, Switzerland's largest university, offers a range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional apprenticeship streams the University offers an inspiring working environment on cutting-edge research and top-class education. Put your talent and skills to work with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
The selected candidate will take a central role in the group's in vitro and in vivo drug-discovery programme. Responsibilities include: (i) setting up in vitro and in vivo blood brain barrier models in the lab and test drug candidates in such models using ELISA or LC-MS etc; (ii) processing brain tissue for histological and biochemical assays, including sectioning (cryostat/microtome), immunohistochemistry and immunofluorescence staining, fluorescence/confocal imaging, quantitative large-batch image analysis, ELISA and western blot assays for brain homogenates; and (iii) supporting cell-based assays, including mammalian cell culture, microglial phagocytosis assays and flow cytometry (FACS). The candidate will also contribute to standard biochemical read-outs (e.g. ELISA, Western blot) and to the careful documentation of experimental data.

Anforderungen:
• PhD degree in biology, neuroscience, biomedicine or a related field. Experience in drug discovery in neurodegeneration is a plus.

• Hands-on experience with blood brain barrier research including setting up in vitro and in vivo models, quantitative analysis of drug penetration. Experience with LC-MS is a strong advantage.

• Solid histology experience: tissue sectioning (cryostat and/or microtome), immunohistochemistry and immunofluorescence staining, fluorescence/confocal microscopy and quantitative analysis of large image batches (e.g. ImageJ/Fiji, QuPath). Experience with staining and quantifying brain pathology (amyloid-β plaques, tau, neuroinflammation markers) is a plus.

• Cellular biology experience, in particular mammalian cell culture and flow cytometry / FACS (sample preparation, acquisition, gating and analysis). Experience with functional cell assays such as phagocytosis is an advantage.

• Careful, reliable and well-documented working style, the ability to work independently and organise large experimental cohorts, and a collaborative team spirit.

• Solid knowledge of English and good communication skills.

Aufgaben:
Il candidato selezionato assumerà un ruolo centrale nel programma in vitro e in vivo di tossicodipendenza del gruppo. Le responsabilità includono: (i) l'impostazione in vitro e in vivo modelli di barriera cerebrale nel laboratorio e testare i candidati alla droga in tali modelli utilizzando ELISA o LC-MS ecc.; (ii) elaborazione del tessuto cerebrale per analisi istologiche e biochimiche, compresa la sezione (criostato / microtomo), immunoistochimica e immunofluorescenza colorazione, fluorescenza / immagine conflocale Il candidato contribuirà anche a riletture biochimiche standard (ad esempio ELISA, Western blot) e all'attenta documentazione dei dati sperimentali.

Anforderungen:
• Dottorato di ricerca in biologia, neuroscienze, biomedicina o un campo correlato. L'esperienza nella scoperta della droga nella neurodegenerazione è un vantaggio.

• Solida esperienza di istologia: sezionamento dei tessuti (criostato e/o microtomo), colorazione immunoistochimica e immunofluorescenza, microscopia fluorescenza/confocale e analisi quantitativa di grandi lotti di immagini (ad esempio ImageJ/Fiji, QuPath). L'esperienza con la colorazione e la patologia del cervello quantificante (piacche di amyloid-β, tau, marcatori di neuroinfiammazione) è un plus.

• Esperienza di biologia cellulare, in particolare la cultura cellulare mammifero e la citometria di flusso / FACS (preparazione del campione, acquisizione, gating e analisi). L'esperienza con saggi cellulari funzionali come la fagocitosi è un vantaggio.

Aufgaben:
Der ausgewählte Kandidat wird eine zentrale Rolle im In-vitro- und In-vivo-Programm der Gruppe einnehmen. Zu den Aufgaben gehören: (i) Einrichtung von In-vitro- und In-vivo-Modellen für die Blut-Hirn-Schranke im Labor und Testmedikamentenkandidaten in solchen Modellen unter Verwendung von ELISA oder LC-MS usw.; (ii) Verarbeitung von Hirngewebe für histologische und biochemische Assays, einschließlich Sektionierung (Kryostat/Mikrotom), Immunhistochemie und Immunfluoreszenzfärbung, Fluoreszenz/konfokale Bildgebung, quantitative Großserienbildanalyse, ELISA und Western-Blot-Assays für Gehirnhomogenate; und (iii) Unterstützung von zellbasierten Assays, einschließlich Säugerzellkultur, Mikrogliaphagozytose-Assays und Durchflusszytometrie (FACS). Der Kandidat wird auch zu standardmäßigen biochemischen Auslesungen (z. B. ELISA, Western Blot) und zur sorgfältigen Dokumentation der experimentellen Daten beitragen.

Anforderungen:
• PhD-Abschluss in Biologie, Neurowissenschaften, Biomedizin oder einem verwandten Bereich. Erfahrung in der Wirkstoffforschung bei Neurodegeneration ist ein Plus.

• Hands-on-Erfahrung mit Blut-Hirn-Schranke-Forschung, einschließlich der Einrichtung von in-vitro-und in-vivo-Modelle, quantitative Analyse der drug penetration. Erfahrung mit LC-MS ist ein großer Vorteil.

• Erfahrung mit solider Histologie: Gewebeschnitt (Kryostat und/oder Mikrotom), Immunhistochemie und Immunfluoreszenzfärbung, Fluoreszenz/Konfokalmikroskopie und quantitative Analyse großer Bildansätze (z. B. ImageJ/Fiji, QuPath). Erfahrungen mit der Färbung und Quantifizierung der Hirnpathologie (Amyloid-β-Plaques, Tau, Neuroinflammationsmarker) sind ein Plus.

• Erfahrung in der Zellbiologie, insbesondere in der Zellkultur von Säugetieren und der Durchflusszytometrie / FACS (Probenpräparation, Gewinnung, Gating und Analyse). Erfahrungen mit funktionellen Zellassays wie Phagozytose sind von Vorteil.

• Sorgfältiger, zuverlässiger und gut dokumentierter Arbeitsstil, die Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten und große experimentelle Kohorten zu organisieren, und ein kooperativer Teamgeist.

• Solide Englischkenntnisse und gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

jobs.title: Professorship of Gastroenterology and Hepatology

titleByLocale.fr: Professeur de gastroentérologie et d'hépatologie

jobs.description:
The University of Zurich offers a wide range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and 12 professional apprenticeship streams, Switzerland's largest university provides an inspiring working environment at the vanguard of research and education. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
We are seeking a dynamic, integrative, and collaborative individual with extensive clinical and scientific experience in gastroenterology or hepatology. A habilitation or an equivalent academic qualification, as well as board certification in gastroenterology (FMH), or an equivalent international qualification, are required. As the future head of the Department of Gastroenterology and Hepatology, we expect the successful candidate to possess a successful leadership track record as head or deputy head of a clinical unit at a university hospital. In addition, you have a strong track record as a research group leader, you have secured competitive third-party funds, and contributed to student teaching, supervision of academic theses, and the promotion of early-career researchers.

We are looking for a participative and integrative leader with proven experience in fostering collaborative, interdisciplinary teamwork. You are able to connect teams across different departments, establish a culture of mutual respect, and actively contribute to the advancement of research, teaching, and clinical care.

Anforderungen:
The University of Zurich offers exceptional conditions for cutting-edge medical research. With its four University Hospitals, the University of Zurich provides access to extensive patient populations, interdisciplinary re-search networks, and clinical expertise across all age groups and specialties. Its proximity to ETH Zurich offers additional opportunities for collaboration in computational medicine, bioengineering, data science, and AI-driven medicine. As a result, the Zurich location offers a translational ecosystem that spans from basic research to clinical application.

German language skills at level B2 of the common European framework of reference for languages should be available or must be acquired within a reasonable period of time.

The University of Zurich is an equal opportunities employer and in particular strives to increase the percentage of women in leading positions. Therefore, qualified female researchers are encouraged to apply.

Our employees benefit from a wide range of attractive offers .

Aufgaben:
Stiamo cercando un individuo dinamico, integrato e collaborativo con una vasta esperienza clinica e scientifica in gastroenterologia o epatologia. Sono necessarie una abilitazione o una qualifica accademica equivalente, nonché la certificazione di bordo in gastroenterologia (FMH), o una qualifica internazionale equivalente. Come futuro capo del Dipartimento di Gastroenterologia ed Epatologia, ci aspettiamo che il candidato di successo possieda un record di leadership di successo come capo o vice capo di un'unità clinica in un ospedale universitario. Inoltre, hai un forte record di traccia come leader di gruppo di ricerca, hai assicurato fondi competitivi di terze parti, e ha contribuito all'insegnamento degli studenti, la supervisione di tesi accademiche, e la promozione di ricercatori di primo piano.

Siamo alla ricerca di un leader partecipativo e integrativo con una comprovata esperienza nella promozione del lavoro di squadra collaborativo e interdisciplinare. Siete in grado di collegare i team di diversi dipartimenti, stabilire una cultura del rispetto reciproco, e contribuire attivamente al progresso della ricerca, dell'insegnamento e della cura clinica.

Anforderungen:
L'Università di Zurigo offre condizioni eccezionali per una ricerca medica all'avanguardia. Con i suoi quattro Ospedali Universitari, l'Università di Zurigo offre l'accesso a vaste popolazioni di pazienti, reti di ricerca interdisciplinari e competenze cliniche in tutti i gruppi di età e specialità. La sua vicinanza a ETH Zurich offre ulteriori opportunità di collaborazione in medicina computazionale, bioingegneria, scienza dei dati e medicina AI-driven. Di conseguenza, la posizione di Zurigo offre un ecosistema traduttivo che spazia dalla ricerca di base all'applicazione clinica.

Le competenze linguistiche tedesche al livello B2 del quadro comune europeo di riferimento per le lingue devono essere disponibili o devono essere acquisite entro un termine ragionevole.

L'Università di Zurigo è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità e in particolare si sforza di aumentare la percentuale di donne in posizioni di leadership. Pertanto, i ricercatori femminili qualificati sono incoraggiati ad applicare.

Aufgaben:
Wir suchen eine dynamische, integrative und kollaborative Person mit umfangreicher klinischer und wissenschaftlicher Erfahrung in der Gastroenterologie oder Hepatologie. Eine Habilitation oder eine gleichwertige akademische Qualifikation sowie eine Board-Zertifizierung in Gastroenterologie (FMH) oder eine gleichwertige internationale Qualifikation sind erforderlich. Als zukünftiger Leiter der Abteilung für Gastroenterologie und Hepatologie erwarten wir, dass der erfolgreiche Kandidat eine erfolgreiche Führungsbilanz als Leiter oder stellvertretender Leiter einer klinischen Einheit in einem Universitätskrankenhaus hat. Darüber hinaus haben Sie eine starke Erfolgsbilanz als Forschungsgruppenleiter, Sie haben sich wettbewerbsfähige Drittmittel gesichert und zum Unterrichten von Studenten, zur Überwachung von akademischen Abschlussarbeiten und zur Förderung von Nachwuchsforschern beigetragen.

Wir suchen eine partizipative und integrative Führungskraft mit ausgewiesener Erfahrung in der Förderung kollaborativer, interdisziplinärer Teamarbeit. Sie sind in der Lage, Teams in verschiedenen Abteilungen zu verbinden, eine Kultur des gegenseitigen Respekts zu etablieren und aktiv zur Förderung von Forschung, Lehre und klinischer Versorgung beizutragen.

Anforderungen:
Die Universität Zürich bietet außergewöhnliche Bedingungen für die medizinische Spitzenforschung. Mit ihren vier Universitätskliniken bietet die Universität Zürich Zugang zu umfangreichen Patientenpopulationen, interdisziplinären Forschungsnetzwerken und klinischem Fachwissen über alle Altersgruppen und Fachgebiete hinweg. Die Nähe zur ETH Zürich bietet zusätzliche Möglichkeiten für die Zusammenarbeit in den Bereichen Computermedizin, Bioengineering, Data Science und KI-gesteuerte Medizin. Damit bietet der Standort Zürich ein translationales Ökosystem, das sich von der Grundlagenforschung bis zur klinischen Anwendung erstreckt.

Deutschkenntnisse auf dem Niveau B2 des gemeinsamen europäischen Referenzrahmens für Sprachen sollten verfügbar sein oder müssen innerhalb eines angemessenen Zeitraums erworben werden.

Die Universität Zürich ist Arbeitgeberin für Chancengleichheit und strebt insbesondere eine Erhöhung des Frauenanteils in Führungspositionen an. Daher werden qualifizierte Forscherinnen ermutigt, sich zu bewerben.

Con i suoi quattro ospedali universitari, offre accesso a ampie popolazioni di pazienti, reti di ricerca interdisciplinari e competenze cliniche in tutte le fasce di età e discipline. La vicinanza a ETH Zurich apre opportunità di cooperazione in medicina computazionale, bioingegneria, scienza dei dati e medicina basata su AI. La posizione di Zurigo offre quindi un ecosistema orientato alla traduzione che spazia dalla ricerca di base all'applicazione clinica.

La conoscenza del tedesco al livello B2 del quadro comune europeo di riferimento per le lingue dovrebbe essere disponibile o deve essere acquisita entro un periodo di tempo utile.

L'Università di Zurigo si sforza di aumentare la percentuale di donne in posizioni dirigenziali. Pertanto, i ricercatori femminili qualificati sono esplicitamente invitati ad applicare.

I nostri dipendenti beneficiano di offerte diverse e attraenti.

With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional profiles for learners, the university offers an inspiring working environment in cutting-edge research and education. Use your talent and skills with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Tasks:
We are looking for a dynamic, integrative and cooperative personality with extensive clinical expertise and scientific experience in gastroenterology or hepatology. A habilitation or equivalent scientific qualification and a specialist title in gastroenterology (FMH) or an equivalent foreign qualification are required. Since you will take over the management of the Clinic of Gastroenterology and Hepatology, you will have experience in the management or deputy management of a university clinical unit. In addition, you have extensive experience in the management of a research group, the acquisition of competitive third-party funding as well as in student teaching, the supervision of qualification work and the academic promotion of young talent.

We are looking for a participatory, value-oriented and inclusive leader with
proven experience in promoting cooperative, interdisciplinary teamwork. They are able to network teams across disciplines, establish an appreciative work culture and actively contribute to the further development of research, teaching and clinical care.

Requirements
The University of Zurich offers exceptional conditions for cutting-edge research in medicine. With its four university hospitals, it offers access to broad patient populations, interdisciplinary research networks and clinical expertise across all age groups and disciplines. The proximity to ETH Zurich opens up opportunities for cooperation in computational medicine, bioengineering, data science and AI-based medicine. The Zurich location thus offers a translationally oriented ecosystem that ranges from basic research to clinical application.

Knowledge of German at level B2 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages should be available or must be acquired within a useful period of time.

The University of Zurich strives to increase the proportion of women in management positions. Therefore, qualified female researchers are explicitly invited to apply.

Our employees benefit from diverse and attractive offers.

jobs.title: Humanpräparator*in

titleByLocale.fr: Préparation humaine

jobs.description:
Als grösste Universität der Schweiz bietet die Universität Zürich eine Vielzahl von attraktiven Positionen in verschiedenen Fachbereichen und Berufsfeldern. Mit rund 10'000 Mitarbeitenden und aktuell 12 Berufsprofilen für Lernende bietet die Universität ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld in der Spitzenforschung und Bildung. Setzen Sie Ihr Talent und Ihre Fähigkeiten bei uns ein. Erfahren Sie mehr über die UZH als Arbeitgeberin!

Aufgaben:
• Sie sind zuständig für die ethisch korrekte Handhabung von Körperspenden und Humanpräparaten bei der Entgegennahme, Konservierung, Lagerung, Pflege und der Vorbereitung zur Kremation.

• Ihnen unterliegt die administrative Verwaltung des Körperspendewesens so wie die Organisation und Betreuung im Bereich der Prosektur- und des Präpariersaals inkl. Sicherstellen der hygienischen und arbeitssicherheitsrelevanter Standards, etc.

• Sie erstellen eigenständig anatomische Präparate und stellen anatomische Präparate und Lehrmittel für Vorlesungen, Seminare, Praktika, Prüfungen und für Forschungszwecke bereit.

• Sie unterstützen Forschungsprojekte, z. B. durch eigenständige Entnahme von Gewebeproben nach wissenschaftlichen Vorgaben

• Sie tragen die Verantwortung für die Vorbereitung und das Einrichten der Unterrichtsräume nach den Bedürfnissen der Lehrveranstaltungen und verrichten die Aufräumarbeiten nach den Kursen inkl. Vor- und Nachbereitung ärztlicher Fort- und Weiterbildung mit Betreuung (ca. 1x jährlich auch am Wochenende)

• Sie sind zuständig für den Unterhalt, Wartung und Reparaturen der technischen Einrichtung, sowie für Inventarisierung und Materialbestellungen des gesamten Arbeitsbereiches der Prosektur und des zugehörigen Lehrbereiches.

• Sie betreuen und pflegen die anatomische Studiensammlung, inklusive Weiterentwicklung und Erstellung von Präparaten für die Sammlung.

Anforderungen:
• Sie verfügen über eine Ausbildung zum/zur Präparator*in mit eidg. Fachausweis oder eine äquivalente Ausbildung (Ausbildung gem. Richtlinien der EU). Mehrere Jahre Arbeitserfahrung auf diesem Gebiet ist von Vorteil.

• Sie besitzen gute Kenntnisse auf dem Gebiet der makroskopischen Anatomie und sind in der Lage, eigenständig Konservierungs-, Präparations-, Mazerations- und Injektionstechniken anzuwenden.

• Sie unterstützen die Weiterentwicklung neuer Methoden zur Fixierung und Herstellung von Geweben, Organen und Präparaten

• Sie zeigen handwerkliches Geschick und Interesse ihre Kenntnisse stetig aktuell zu halten.

• Sie unterstützen den Einsatz moderner Methoden zur Ergänzung der Lehre (digital, virtuell)

• Sie arbeiten selbstständig und exakt, sind pflichtbewusst, zuverlässig und belastbar. Flexibilität bei den Arbeitseinsätzen wird vorausgesetzt.

• Sie besitzten eine kommunikative und teamfähige Persönlichkeit, sowie die Fähigkeit zur einfühlsamen Kommunikation mit Angehörigen von Spendenden und an der Körperspende Interessierten.

• Sie zeigen eine hohe Bereitschaft zur Dienstleistung und sind Bereit mit Wissenschaftler*innen, medizini-schem Personal und Studierenden zusammenzuarbeiten.

• Sie verfügen über gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Gute Italienischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift erwünscht.

• Englisch- und oder Französischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

• Sie besitzten gute Computerkenntnisse als Grundlage für administrative Arbeiten (MS Office, E-Mail-Programme, Internet, etc.)

Wir bieten:
Unsere Mitarbeitenden profitieren von vielfältigen und attraktiven Angeboten. Erfahre mehr unter: https://www.uzh.ch/de/explore/work.html.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Come la più grande università in Svizzera, l'Università di Zurigo offre un gran numero di posizioni attraenti in varie discipline e campi professionali. Con circa 10.000 dipendenti e attualmente 12 profili professionali per gli studenti, l'università offre un ambiente di lavoro stimolante nella ricerca e nell'istruzione all'avanguardia. Usa il tuo talento e le tue abilità con noi. Scopri di più su UZH come datore di lavoro!

Compiti:
• Sono responsabili della corretta gestione etica delle donazioni corporee e dei preparati umani nella ricezione, conservazione, stoccaggio, cura e preparazione della cremazione.

• Essi sono soggetti all'amministrazione amministrativa del sistema di donazione del corpo, nonché all'organizzazione e al supporto nell'area del Prosektur- e la sala di preparazione incl. Garantire norme igieniche e professionali in materia di sicurezza, ecc.

• Essi producono indipendentemente preparazioni anatomiche e forniscono preparati anatomici e materiali didattici per lezioni, seminari, stage, esami e scopi di ricerca.

• Sostengono i progetti di ricerca, ad esempio con rimozione indipendente dei campioni di tessuto secondo specifiche scientifiche,

• Essi sono responsabili di preparare e configurare le aule in base alle esigenze dei corsi e svolgere il lavoro di pulizia secondo i corsi incl. Preparazione e follow-up di educazione medica e formazione con cura (circa 1x ogni anno anche nei fine settimana)

• Sono responsabili per la manutenzione, la manutenzione e la riparazione delle attrezzature tecniche, nonché per l'inventario e gli ordini materiali dell'intera area di lavoro della prefettura e dell'area didattica associata.

• Essi supervisionano e mantengono la collezione di studi anatomici, tra cui ulteriore sviluppo e preparazione dei preparativi per la raccolta.

Requisiti
• Hai una formazione a / al preparatore con eidg. Certificato professionale o formazione equivalente (formazione secondo le direttive UE. Diversi anni di esperienza lavorativa in questo campo è vantaggioso.

• Hanno una buona conoscenza nel campo dell'anatomia macroscopica e sono in grado di applicare indipendentemente la conservazione, la preparazione, la macerazione e le tecniche di iniezione.

• Essi sostengono l'ulteriore sviluppo di nuovi metodi per il fissaggio e la produzione di tessuti, organi e preparati

• Essi mostrano l'artigianato e l'interesse a mantenere le loro conoscenze costantemente aggiornate.

• Supportano l'uso di metodi moderni per integrare l'insegnamento (digitale, virtuale)

• Funzionano in modo indipendente e preciso, sono dutiful, affidabile e resiliente. È richiesta flessibilità nelle assegnazioni di lavoro.

• Avevano una personalità comunicativa e di squadra, nonché la capacità di comunicare empaticamente con i parenti dei donatori e quelli interessati alla donazione del corpo.

• Essi mostrano un'elevata disponibilità a fornire servizi e sono pronti a lavorare insieme a scienziati, personale medico e studenti.

• Hanno una buona conoscenza del tedesco nelle parole e nella scrittura. Buona conoscenza dell'italiano in parola e la scrittura è desiderata.

• Le competenze in inglese e/o francese sono vantaggiose.

• Avevano buone competenze informatiche come base per il lavoro amministrativo (Ufficio dello SME, programmi di posta elettronica, Internet, ecc.)

Offriamo:
I nostri dipendenti beneficiano di offerte diverse e attraenti. Per saperne di più: https://www.uzh.ch/en/explore/work.html
descriptionByLocale.en:
As the largest university in Switzerland, the University of Zurich offers a large number of attractive positions in various disciplines and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional profiles for learners, the university offers an inspiring working environment in cutting-edge research and education. Use your talent and skills with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Tasks:
• They are responsible for the ethically correct handling of body donations and human preparations in the reception, preservation, storage, care and preparation for cremation.

• They are subject to the administrative administration of the body donation system as well as the organization and support in the area of the Prosektur- and the preparation room incl. Ensuring hygienic and occupational safety-related standards, etc.

• They independently produce anatomical preparations and provide anatomical preparations and teaching materials for lectures, seminars, internships, exams and research purposes.

• They support research projects, e.g. by independent removal of tissue samples according to scientific specifications,

• They are responsible for preparing and setting up the classrooms according to the needs of the courses and carry out the clean-up work according to the courses incl. Preparation and follow-up of medical education and training with care (about 1x annually also at weekends)

• They are responsible for the maintenance, maintenance and repairs of the technical equipment, as well as for inventory and material orders of the entire working area of the prefecture and the associated teaching area.

• They supervise and maintain the anatomical study collection, including further development and preparation of preparations for the collection.

Requirements
• You have an education to / to the preparator with eidg. Professional certificate or equivalent training (training according to m. EU directives. Several years of work experience in this field is beneficial.

• They have good knowledge in the field of macroscopic anatomy and are able to independently apply preservation, preparation, maceration and injection techniques.

• They support the further development of new methods for fixing and producing tissues, organs and preparations

• They show craftsmanship and interest to keep their knowledge constantly up-to-date.

• They support the use of modern methods to supplement teaching (digital, virtual)

• They work independently and accurately, are dutiful, reliable and resilient. Flexibility in work assignments is required.

• They had a communicative and team-capable personality, as well as the ability to communicate empathetically with relatives of donors and those interested in body donation.

• They show a high willingness to provide services and are ready to work together with scientists, medical staff and students.

• They have a good knowledge of German in words and writing. Good knowledge of Italian in word and writing is desired.

• English and/or French skills are beneficial.

• They had good computer skills as a basis for administrative work (MS Office, e-mail programs, Internet, etc.)

We offer:
Our employees benefit from diverse and attractive offers. Find out more at: https://www.uzh.ch/en/explore/work.html

• Ils sont soumis à l'administration du système de don de corps ainsi que l'organisation et le soutien dans le domaine du Prosektur- et la salle de préparation incl. Assurer des normes d'hygiène et de sécurité au travail, etc.

• Ils produisent indépendamment des préparations anatomiques et fournissent des préparations anatomiques et du matériel pédagogique pour des conférences, des séminaires, des stages, des examens et des recherches.

• Ils soutiennent des projets de recherche, par exemple par l'enlèvement indépendant d'échantillons de tissus selon les spécifications scientifiques,

• Ils sont chargés de préparer et de mettre en place les salles de classe en fonction des besoins des cours et d'effectuer les travaux de nettoyage selon les cours inclus. Préparation et suivi de l ' enseignement et de la formation médicaux avec soins (environ 1 fois par an également le week-end)

• Ils sont responsables de l'entretien, de l'entretien et de la réparation de l'équipement technique, ainsi que de l'inventaire et des commandes matérielles de l'ensemble de la zone de travail de la préfecture et du domaine d'enseignement associé.

• Ils supervisent et maintiennent la collection d'études anatomiques, y compris le développement et la préparation des préparatifs de la collection.

Exigences
• Vous avez une éducation à / au préparateur avec eidg. Certificat professionnel ou formation équivalente (formation selon les directives de l'UE). Plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle dans ce domaine sont bénéfiques.

• Ils ont une bonne connaissance dans le domaine de l'anatomie macroscopique et sont en mesure d'appliquer indépendamment les techniques de conservation, de préparation, de macération et d'injection.

• Ils soutiennent le développement de nouvelles méthodes de fixation et de production de tissus, d'organes et de préparations

• Ils montrent l'artisanat et l'intérêt pour garder leurs connaissances constamment à jour.

• Ils soutiennent l'utilisation de méthodes modernes pour compléter l'enseignement (numérique, virtuel)

• Ils travaillent de façon indépendante et précise, sont dignes de foi, fiables et résilients. La flexibilité des tâches est nécessaire.

• Ils avaient une personnalité communicative et capable d'équipe, ainsi que la capacité de communiquer empathiquement avec les parents des donneurs et ceux qui s'intéressent au don corporel.

• Ils montrent une grande volonté de fournir des services et sont prêts à travailler avec les scientifiques, le personnel médical et les étudiants.

• Ils ont une bonne connaissance de l'allemand en paroles et en écriture. Une bonne connaissance de l'italien en paroles et en écriture est souhaitée.

• Les compétences en anglais et/ou en français sont bénéfiques.

• Ils avaient de bonnes compétences en informatique comme base de travail administratif (Bureau du SM, programmes de courrier électronique, Internet, etc.)

Nos employés bénéficient d'offres variées et attrayantes. Pour en savoir plus: https://www.uzh.ch/fr/explore/work.html

jobs.description:

Mit rund 10'000 Mitarbeitenden und aktuell 12 Berufsprofilen für Lernende bietet die Universität ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld in der Spitzenforschung und Bildung. Setzen Sie Ihr Talent und Ihre Fähigkeiten bei uns ein. Erfahren Sie mehr über die UZH als Arbeitgeberin!

Aufgaben:
Als studentische Hilfskraft unterstützen Sie die Geschäftsstelle der School for Transdisciplinary Studies in studienadministrativen und organisatorischen Belangen sowie bei der Durchführung von Kommunikationsmassnahmen. Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören insbesondere:

• Organisatorische und inhaltliche Unterstützung der studienadministrativen Prozesse der STS

• Mitarbeit bei der Semesterplanung und Pflege des Vorlesungsverzeichnisses

• Aufbereitung und Auswertung von Modulbuchungen und Teilnahmequoten

• Vorbereitung und Organisation von Veranstaltungen und Gremiensitzungen inkl. der Erstellung von Präsentationen

• Rechercheaufgaben für die Erstellung von Memos und Konzepten

• Mitarbeit an und Weiterentwicklung von Kommunikationsmassnahmen inkl. Pflege der entsprechenden Kanäle (z.B. Website, Newsletter)

• Pflege von Social-Media (v.a. Instagram)

Anforderungen:
Sie befinden sich im fortgeschrittenen Bachelor- oder bereits im Masterstudium und begreifen sich als Teamplayer:in. Sie verfügen über ein hohes Mass an Eigenständigkeit und können sich rasch und flexibel auf neue Aufgaben einstellen. Gut ausgeprägte Selbstlernfähigkeiten, sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und eine gewissenhafte und qualitätsbewusste Arbeitsweise runden Ihr Profil ab.
Sie können sich stilsicher auf Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift ausdrücken. Erste Arbeitserfahrungen (über Praktika, Nebenjobs, Ehrenamt) sind erwünscht. Kenntnisse in Content Management Programmen (z.B. Magnolia) und Layout- und Schnittprogrammen (z.B. Canva) sind von Vorteil.
